mapper.insert: insert into review( vno, rating, content, review_image, reg_date ) values ( #{review.vno}, #{review.rating}, #{review.content}, #{review.reviewImage}, now() )
mapper.select: select r.rno, r.vno, r.rating, r.content, r.review_image, r.reg_date, m.nickname, p.name as place_name from review r join visit v on r.vno = v.vno join member m on m.mno = v.mno join place p on p.pno = v.pno order by r.rno desc

select r.rno, r.vno, r.rating, r.content, r.review_image, r.reg_date, m.nickname, p.name as place_name from review r join visit v on r.vno = v.vno join member m on m.mno = v.mno join place p on p.pno = v.pno where r.rno = #{rno}

SELECT r.rno, r.vno, r.rating, r.content, r.review_image, r.reg_date, m.nickname, p.name AS place_name FROM review r JOIN visit v ON r.vno = v.vno JOIN member m ON m.mno = v.mno JOIN place p ON p.pno = v.pno ORDER BY r.rno DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.rno, r.rating, r.content, r.reg_date, m.nickname, p.name AS place_name FROM review r JOIN visit v ON v.vno = r.vno JOIN member m ON m.mno = v.mno JOIN place p ON p.pno = v.pno WHERE v.status = 1 ORDER BY r.rno DESC, r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 3
